tools.name: get_load
tools.description: Return the current served load (MW) for the control area and the immediate trend.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Return current generation by asset (MW online, type, headroom) and the total online MW.

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Return the short-horizon forecast for load and per-type generation (notably renewables) over the next few intervals.

tools.name: get_reserves
tools.description: Return reserve capacity: how much is available to commit, how much is already committed, and the time-to-online for each reserve resource.

tools.name: asset_status
tools.description: Return per-asset health/derate flags and any condition warnings reported by the units.

tools.name: frequency
tools.description: Return the current system frequency (Hz), the nominal frequency, and the operating limits.

tools.name: commit_reserve
tools.description: Commit reserve capacity (MW) so it is available to balance the area. Committing reserve has a standby cost but no energy is delivered until you dispatch it.

tools.name: set_dispatch_strategy
tools.description: Set the balancing strategy used at settlement: 'static' (hold current dispatch) or 'follow' (let committed reserve respond to balance the area).

tools.name: dispatch
tools.description: Adjust the output set-point of an asset by deltaMw (positive = ramp up, negative = ramp down). Bounded by the asset's headroom.

tools.name: shed_load
tools.description: Curtail (shed) load by mw to relieve a supply shortfall. Sheds firm customer demand and carries a high penalty — use only as a last resort.

tools.name: settle_interval
tools.description: Advance and settle the dispatch interval. The system resolves load against generation and reserves; returns the graded outcome (frequency/balance held within limits, at what cost).
